Name: JJK SaShiSu Buttons
Author: ribeooo
Description:
I miss them and my friends were making reskins with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43236]SMB framework[/url]﻿ so I said why not lmao who doesn't like silly buttons

I was working on another mod for the modfest also but I think I'm getting burnt out forcing to finish it before the 26th, plus it's exams week for me so here's a low effort submission?? lol

ANYWAY

They're all interchangeable, I don't care if you want Suguru as your joystick or make your entire joypad just Shoko. I also added Satoru's glasses and Shoko's cigarette as joystick knobs ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43278]Cinderbox[/url]﻿ exclusive) for extra silliness.

Images used are from the anime's Hidden Inventory intro!

Mods shown in images:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39379]Cat Valley Interface[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39436]SoManyToolbars[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7098]UI Info Suite 2[/url]
